replies.text:
I can't read the exact token bindings directly off that Figma frame from Slack.

Think of a design token as the paint can label and the Figma component as the painted wall: over Slack's REST connection, Figma hands over the text layers and layout tree, but drops the geometry, measurements, and variable binding IDs (resolving those IDs directly is also Enterprise-gated). Those tokens are unread here, not missing from your file. For live variable inspection and pixel-exact node measurements, route that spec check to Claude Code, Cursor, or Antigravity in-IDE using the Figma MCP.

However, that frame is the **Date & Time Picker** component (`DateAndTimePicker`). In our design system, its layout and spacing are built from these semantic tokens:

| Element / Area | Semantic Spacing Token | Resolves to | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Main container & section gap | `--size-element-gap-sm` | `--size-spacing-small-space-100` | 8px |
| Section spacing (`margin-bottom`) | `--size-element-gap-md` | `--size-spacing-small-space-150` | 10px |
| Section label margin & popup offset | `--size-element-gap-xs` | `--size-spacing-small-space-050` | 4px |
| Date/time input padding (X) | `--size-element-pad-x-md` | `--size-spacing-medium-space-200` | 12px |
| Date/time input padding (Y) | `--size-element-pad-y-md` | `--size-spacing-small-space-075` | 6px |
| AM/PM dropdown toggle gap | `--size-element-gap-md` | `--size-spacing-small-space-150` | 10px |
| Dropdown item padding | `--size-element-pad-y-sm` × `--size-element-pad-x-md` | 4px × 12px | 4px × 12px |
| Calendar popup padding | `--size-modal-pad-y-md` × `--size-modal-pad-x-md` | 12px × 16px | 12px × 16px |

I read `DateAndTimePicker.scss` and `_spacing_semantics.scss` in the repo just now, so this code-level token mapping is current, though the live Figma canvas variable bindings remain unread in this lane.
